listing.name: Nes's SAW
listing.aiSummary: Adds custom ships, weapons, portraits, and paintjobs.

description:
Nes's SAW
Ships with cosmetic Skins. Splendid!

Includes:
-a handful of lovingly crafted ships, a weapon, as well as few portraits
-custom paintjobs for ships, access them in the refit screen
-exploration content to discover while traveling across the sector
-main menu mission to get acquainted with some of the new content

Download:
Patreon

Requires LazyLib
Requires MagicLib

Nes's SAW can be safely added to an existing save.
To install, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

To update a mod, first remove the old folder, then move in the new, updated one.
Merging or replacing a folder without removing the old one is one of the most common causes of crashes!

New ships:

New paintjobs for the vanilla ships:

And more!

Portraits:

Player-exclusive portraits are only available during character creation and will not otherwise appear ingame.

Weapons:

Laevatein Assault Cannon

Large Ballistic
- triple barreled, rotary configuration of the venerable Mjolnir
-fires the same devastating round, in a prolonged burst
-more flux efficient, if all shots land
-high upfront flux cost per salvo
-less overall dps
-barrels go speeen~

Spoiler
Hellbore alternative look

Essentially a visual update for the vanilla hellbore

If you prefer vanilla looks simply remove hellbore_ sprites located in graphics/weapons from the mod folder.

Credits:
Art, Implementation, and Bad Ideas: Nes
Special Thanks: Nia, DR, Luzaitis, and many other Unofficial Starsector Discord fine folks
Additional Thanks: Trylobot and Deathfly for the invaluable ship and weapon editor, LazyLib and MagicLib for making life easier, Fractal Softworks team for creating an excellent game and finally you, the player

changelog.1.27.SSS:
all cosmetics are now located under the paintjobs menu in the refit screen

Carnelian: absolutely essential
-built-in drones now match the mothership paintjob

Fluorspar: putting glass in a glass cannon, a delicate flower
-added Delicate Machinery hullmod

Hampter: more loadout variety, more bees, more fun
-Tried and Tested: reworked, now allows the installation of a Converted Hangar

Hammerfall: reworked: more reliable, more utility, still dirt cheap
-built-in Heavy Mining Drill redesigned, is now a more flux efficient long range support beam
-flux 5000 > 4000
-dissipation 300 > 225
-shield arc 70 > 270
-shield efficiency 1 > 0.8
-cargo 160 > 240
-cr to deploy 12 > 10
-is now a Civilian-grade Hull

added Hampter (P)
added Hermitaur (P)
added Hammerfall (P)

updated ship distribution weights
updated variants
updated descriptions
recompiled the mod for java 17
changelog.1.23.SSS:
Hammerfall:
Promoted to a full combat ship bringing utility and damage to the vanilla destroyer lineup in the form of remotely deployed explosives
-removed civilian grade hullmod
-added surveying equipment

-removed built-in mining drill
-added a forward facing small missile hardpoint

-medium hardpoints hybrid > energy
-back turrets energy > hybrid

-system maneuvering jets > makeshift mine

-armor 600 > 650
-flux 4000 > 3600
-dissipation 225 > 200
-op 80 > 90
-top speed 75 > 90
-shield arc 270 > 300
-dp 7 > 10

Hermitaur:
Less backpedal ability, more forward mobility
Added layer of interaction between system and weapons, enabling to literally catapult missiles forward
-system maneuvering jets > reactor burn

Hampter:
-armor 700 > 750

Hampter (Mk.V):
makes it two needles in a haystack
-total number of derelicts to discover across the sector 1 > 2

Paintjobs:
Can Carnelian ever have too many color schemes? No, of course not
-added "Moon Bunny" Carnelian
-added "Moon Bunny" Hammerfall

crossmod content with SEEKER:
-added "Dune" 557
-added "Path" 557
